resources.store: Configured owner-scoped secret provider, outside Identity PostgreSQL
resources.purpose: Native verification for first-code activation, primary MFA and exact-operation proof
resources.access_recipients: Server-side real ITotpSeedStore via finite scoped transport; the authorized User receives seed/URI once. No Admin/Support seed interface or Product recipient is introduced.
resources.binding: Server allocation only; account/authenticator/generation/enrollment/binding-version exact match, resource prefix plus authenticator/generation, version1 and create-only CAS. Reads stay pinned to version1.
resources.lifecycle: Disabled/abandoned references remain in the vault. Adapter has no delete/retire API. Logical disable blocks new verification via Identity metadata; provider retirement/destruction requires a separate explicit retention action.
resources.processing_retention_refs: Policy ProcessingReference/RetentionReference are copied into owner metadata; provider binding/retention rules and processor/residency are not selected for production.
resources.rights_and_protection: No direct privacy export/erase path for seeds; any owner-authorized retirement must honor holds/evidence and never export the seed as ordinary evidence. Production vault encryption/key custody is not certified by this code review.
resources.owner: Tunner Identity; Account references remain Accounts-owned. No Product membership or entitlement authority.

resources.purpose: Cross-context replay denial including A-to-B-to-A for the same immutable factor generation
resources.access_recipients: Server-only native verifier under the shared owner lock; never a User/Admin/Support response.
resources.representation: Salted ASP.NET IdentityV3 password-hasher verifier of canonical6-digit code, with explicit supported iteration/resource bounds; not a plaintext OTP or a secret seed. Small code space means verifier rows remain restricted.
resources.lifecycle: ExpiresAt marks the conservative native acceptance horizon, including clock/work bounds. Expired rows are removed only during the next successful acceptance for that factor/generation; no periodic sweep. ReplayRetention is a technical anti-replay horizon, not evidence that a legal maximum-retention deadline is enforced.
resources.protection: All live claims checked; time and live-claim/CPU limits fail closed. Never evict an unexpired claim to accept another code.

resources.purpose: Safe audit/notification intent plus authorized setup/verification
resources.access_recipients: Shared post-commit outbox consumers receive references only. HTTPS User receives one-time setup material; local client QR renderer receives it in memory, with no external QR service.
resources.lifecycle: DisclosureClaimedAt commits before returning key/URI; a lost response does not disclose again. Outbox security metadata follows its shared policy, not seed deletion.
resources.protection: Cache-Control no-store, Pragma no-cache, no-referrer; reject query strings; Secure/HttpOnly/Strict protected owner/pending selection cookies. processing_governance.legal_basis_and_notice: No production legal basis, notice/consent category or applicability is selected. User-initiated enrollment is not treated as blanket legal consent for processing.
processing_governance.processor_recipients: Configured secret-provider processing and the authorized User disclosure are described above. No additional Product or external QR processor is introduced.
processing_governance.residency_transfer_profile: Unselected for production; a test-only loopback vault is not evidence of production residency, transfer or processor approval.
processing_governance.privacy_request_capabilities: No TOTP-specific export, erase or anonymization endpoint is introduced. Future owner projections/actions must exclude secret values and preserve required security evidence and holds.
processing_governance.retention_holds: No TOTP hold-aware destruction pipeline is implemented. References/expiry timestamps do not substitute for an approved trigger/action/hold policy or successful physical deletion.

output_exclusions: No raw seed or submitted OTP in Identity persistence, outbox/event payloads, diagnostic output, URLs or evidence. Seed storage is the explicitly bound secret provider.
No Admin/Support password/seed/private-material projection; ordinary metadata views omit provider resource references.
Public rendering/privacy canaries do not constitute real BFF/native/vault end-to-end validation. No new runtime or test execution was performed for this inventory.
retention_boundary: Access expiry, business disable and physical deletion are separate. Current code enforces authentication/recovery validity and opportunistic replay cleanup, not a full periodic metadata/vault retention pipeline. Exact legal periods, approved processor/residency, hold policy, publication and production provider/profile remain unselected. No blanket compliance/production PASS.
